name: Ninomiya Shiina
source:
"Yes, I'm the director, Shiina Ninomiya. We're currently developing DLC for the second installment of World's Odyssey. It's called 'End to Odyssey!' It's only been released in Japan, so we're working hard to bring it worldwide."

She was the director of World's Odyssey, a VR-compatible MMORPG that remains wildly popular in this world. Currently, she's focused on directing its official sequel, End to Odyssey. She was once in a traffic accident with her mother. Her mother later passed away after developing a condition from the crash. As for Shiina, she also suffered life-threatening injuries, but narrowly survived—thanks to unexpectedly becoming a Luden. This is an extremely rare phenomenon, even on a global scale. She's incredibly lucky.

As a unique Luden and a beautiful director, she's gained a strong following among game fans. That said, she doesn't make many public appearances, so she's more of a "if you know you know" type of figure.

Leveraging the connections she built during End to Odyssey, she's still chasing new dreams. The development of her new title is her top priority. Her number one partner is Arata Mizunashi, who is currently missing. She treasures [url=/c160572]Sayaka[/url], who became her roommate, just as much as she treasures Arata! Balancing her role as Sayaka's guardian and her duties as a director, she stands against the threats to this world!

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category1&ch=shina]official website[/url]]
